scope: The available task premises do not support a new nontrivial same-contribution theory route. This does not evaluate the unseen primary proposal, prove that future routes are impossible, or change original scoped L4.

new_evidence_interpretation.positive_fact: The declared weak short-budget fusion retention screen passes on the reported exposed train2361/valid1024 cohort, seed307, four epochs.
new_evidence_interpretation.direct_component_fact: At the same selected model, lambda-off has the same reported Macro and accuracy and slightly better CE. These aggregate results do not show a positive direct phase utility on that cohort.
new_evidence_interpretation.prediction_equality_limit: Equal Macro and accuracy do not establish identical per-example predictions, confusion matrices, logits or probabilities. The packet does not supply paired on/off predictions needed to assert any such identity.
new_evidence_interpretation.causal_limit: Fusion-versus-other-training comparisons change more than the component isolated by the frozen lambda-off replay. Their retention difference cannot be assigned to phase from the supplied evidence.
new_evidence_interpretation.training_limit: Rising four-epoch learning curves leave mature performance unresolved. They neither predict that phase usefulness will appear with a larger budget nor establish that phase had an indirect beneficial training effect.
new_evidence_interpretation.object_identity_limit: The fusion head removes the original global relation effect and introduces entity-conditioned effects. Its physical/channel/replay review and weak retention do not inherit the original full-data L4 utility evidence.

concrete_missing_task_premise.premise: An independently supported task distinction for which the introduced component supplies useful label-relevant variation not already accounted for by the matched channels; alternatively, an independently justified task-population/training premise under which the same available information is learned more reliably with that component. Neither additional information nor exclusive quantum utility is required as a universal rule.
concrete_missing_task_premise.why_missing: The packet supplies no independent label/evidence or learning law making either distinction predictively useful. Existing entity markers and jointly trained utilities leave alternate channels open. The selected-model ablation offers no positive direct utility evidence; no controlled training intervention establishes a beneficial learning effect.
what_does_not_supply_it: A nonzero imaginary trace or a physically valid fusion effect
A synthetic distinguishability example selected to favor the new component
A small retraining retention gain without matching its causal alternatives
An untested claim that the phase component improved optimization earlier in training
A claim that the old global-complex model or all suitable classical controls necessarily lack the relevant distinction

why_no_theorem_target_or_new_prediction_: A theorem about the known partial-swap ellipse, positivity or imaginarity would describe a known mechanism rather than supply the missing task premise. A theorem claiming task utility would need that premise or another independently justified population/training assumption. A new prediction is not implied by the supplied short-budget aggregates. Inventing an advantageous task law or switching to an optimization-aid story after the direct ablation would add an unsupported hypothesis, not complete the same contribution.

classical_equivalence_and_control.ordinary_contribution_boundary: Classical simulability is not a rejection criterion, and exclusive quantum utility is not required. A useful ordinary entity-conditioned mechanism could still be a legitimate contribution with its own task evidence and novelty audit.
classical_equivalence_and_control.component_control_boundary: The existing same-selected lambda-off comparison is directly relevant to the current component-use claim. It does not identify the result of separately training a matched phase-free head. Those are distinct causal questions and must not substitute for each other.
classical_equivalence_and_control.comparison_needed_if_a_new_premise_appea: A control would have to preserve the task-relevant entity conditioning, available information, readout capacity and declared training/selection conditions while isolating the new proposed link. There is no justified new link here from which to specify that control.
classical_equivalence_and_control.no_rescue_inference: Failure to establish phase utility does not prove that the whole fusion head is useless, that all coherent methods fail, or that a stronger training-budget claim is false. It limits the present component claim only.

nearest_work_and_novelty_status.consequence: No novelty claim is supported by reusing these identities. The packet also states that old global complex effects already distinguish some conjugate tokens, so a three-state witness alone does not separate the actual old and new task-function families.
nearest_work_and_novelty_status.novelty_verdict: Unverified beyond the packet's reported collisions; no claim of exhaustive literature coverage.

minimal_condition_to_reopen: First state one independently motivated task event or training-population premise that predicts a failure of the matched alternative and a success of the proposed component. Name the existing alternate channels, the intended causal estimand, the deciding observable and a prospective failure rule. Then inspect the smallest evidence capable of separating those explanations. The packet does not establish this premise, so no new diagnostic, retraining or restoration is requested here.
stop_rules: Stop direct component-utility promotion from the current aggregate screen: Macro/accuracy do not improve under the on-versus-off comparison and CE does not favor on.
Do not replace the failed positive utility link with a known geometric or imaginarity identity.
Do not infer positive earlier-training mediation solely because a trained model retained performance or because all curves are rising.

If the research claim changes to an ordinary phase-free/entity-conditioned head, reassess that changed contribution with its own evidence and novelty; do not transfer original L4 or call that a phase rescue.
A later genuinely new task-backed premise should be evaluated independently. This packet-level recommendation is not a universal block.
